theorem: For every finite rank-four string group with distinct nonidentity marks and extreme independence s0 notin G123 and s3 notin G012, every prime p>4|G| admits a finite marked string C-group cover with p-group kernel.
polytope_corollary: Every finite rank-four polytope with non-C monodromy has infinitely many finite minimal regular polytopal covers, one of nontrivial p-power degree for each p>4|Mon(P)|.
finite_computation_scope: Five exact base homology computations with symbolic safe paths; no enumeration of the full large-p homology cover.
prior_project_proofs: phase211 surface criterion and raw phase224 arguments, all necessary arguments restated in phase256
prior_known_results: Finite regular-cover existence (Monson–Schulte); Tomotope finite infinitude (Monson–Pellicer–Williams); earlier project family theorems and arbitrary-cover theorem.
novelty_limit: Bounded primary literature search found no previous general finite rank-four p-kernel theorem; no exhaustive historical priority claim.
excluded_files: Other working phase256 investigations, prefix diagnostics and failed approaches are not part of this theorem packet.
